title: Mover Quote Spread Analysis
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mover:quote quote_usd=* vendor_name=*
| stats min(quote_usd) as low_quote, max(quote_usd) as high_quote, avg(quote_usd) as avg_quote
| eval spread_usd=round(high_quote-low_quote,2), spread_pct=round(100*(high_quote-low_quote)/nullif(low_quote,0),1)
description: Calculates the dollar and percentage spread between lowest and highest mover quotes received.
value: Quote spread shows whether you are comparing like-for-like estimates or talking to outliers.
implementation: Collect at least three `mover:quote` events with `quote_usd` before signing a contract.
visualization: Single-value tiles for spread dollars and percent.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how far apart your highest and lowest mover quotes were.
